refnamediv.refpurpose: Inserts or updates a variable in shared memory

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.description;
boolshm_put_var SysvSharedMemoryshm intkey mixedvalue
shm_put_var inserts or updates the value with the given key.
An E_WARNING is emitted, and &false; returned, if there was not enough shared memory remaining to complete the request. The old value of the key is removed before the new one is checked against the free space, so an update that does not fit leaves the key absent, not unchanged.
The data area is the size of the segment minus the 40-byte segment header (64-bit builds); each variable takes its serialized length plus a chunk header, rounded up to a multiple of 8 bytes.

&reftitle.parameters;
shm
A shared memory segment obtained from shm_attach.
key
The variable key.
value
The variable. All variable types that serialize supports may be used: generally this means all types except for some internal objects that cannot be serialized. A resource is accepted but is stored as 0.

&reftitle.errors;
Throws an Error if shm was detached with shm_detach, or if it was detached while __serialize or __sleep ran during the call. Any exception thrown by serialization, for example for a Closure, is propagated.
